service.name: PIOS Cloudflare Tunnel
service.description: Named Cloudflare Tunnel exposing the PIOS pilot surface (frontend on 127.0.0.1:4173) at a stable public HTTPS hostname, so driver invitation links survive a restart. Decision and full setup: docs/PIOS_NAMED_TUNNEL_DEPLOYMENT.md. Deliberately points only at the frontend, never directly at any of the five backend modules -- exactly as `frontend/vite.config.ts`'s own `preview.proxy` table already fans requests out to them (PIOS_PILOT_INFRASTRUCTURE_DECISION.md; PILOT_INFRASTRUCTURE_ROUTING_DECISION.md Variant A). Does not touch, replace, or route to `platform-ops` -- that hostname, if it is ever added, is separate, unratified work under ADR-048 and is explicitly out of scope of this service.
